text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I slept like a baby, and I even went 
marvelous-hunting first thing this

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then, I found a little bird that fell 
out of its nest, and I put it right back 
in.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The mama bird said thank you and sang me a 
song in return☆ La la la~ What a wonderful 
girl~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:

today too! A marvelous to all these

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday was high-spirited from 
the early morning. It seems she had quite 
a fulfilling day off.
